newsitem.title: CANADA: Bre-X heats up on deal speculation.
newsitem.headline: Bre-X heats up on deal speculation.

text.p: Bre-X Minerals Ltd shares heated up again on Thursday on speculation about whether Bre-X had reached an agreement with its Indonesian partners over the huge Busang gold deposit.
Bre-X bounded up 1.50 to 24.25 in early trading today on the Toronto Stock Exchange. More than one million shares changed hands. On Nasdaq, Bre-X was up 1 to 17-7/8.
"Everybody has whipped themselves into a frenzy over whether there's a deal or not a deal," said gold analyst John Ing from Maison Placements Canada.

The Indonesian government has asked Bre-X and Barrick Gold Corp to reach agreements with their Indonesian partners by the middle of February so the companies can proceed with a plan to develop the Busang gold find.
The Toronto Globe and Mail quoted unnamed sources on Thursday saying Bre-X had reached a deal with its partners.
But the sources were uncertain whether Barrick would wind up as Bre-X's partner or if rival Placer Dome Inc would win access to Busang through its merger proposal with Bre-X.
In an interview on Wednesday, Bre-X chief executive David Walsh told Reuters he was "positive" a deal with Bre-X's partners would be reached by next Monday.
"We will meet the February 17 deadline. I'm confident that we will meet it," Walsh said.
But he would not confirm or deny rumors that a deal had already been sealed.
Meanwhile Indonesia's Mines and Energy Minister Ida Bagus Sudjana said in Jakarta on Thursday that he was still awaiting an update from Bre-X and Barrick about their negotiations.
"They are still negotiating on Busang. I have not met with them yet. I will wait until the deadline on February 17," Sudjana told reporters.
